wayback.notes: gau ran against tumblr.com, automattic.com, wordpress.com — returned 1000 URLs total. word_boundary grep ( tumblr-backup ) found 0 hits. applied rule rule-ownership_verifier-wayback_match_mode-879f3: wayback_match_mode=word_boundary

dns_chain.notes: Bucket DNS resolves via generic AWS global S3 CNAME (s3-3-w.amazonaws.com). No CNAME from any program-owned domain pointing to this bucket. Inconclusive by construction for buckets — anyone can register this name.

notes: applied rule rule-ownership_verifier-wayback_match_mode-879f3: word_boundary grep used for Wayback check to avoid brand-stem degenerate matches on 'tumblr' URL paths. applied rule rule-ownership_verifier-bucket_aggregation_override-1c25c: A=neg, B=neg, C=inconclusive for a bucket promotes standard 'unknown' to 'unowned'. Tumblr is Automattic-owned (acquired 2019) and in-scope, but ownership of the S3 bucket specifically cannot be established — the bucket name 'tumblr-backup' is a brand+suffix pattern that any third party could have registered; no code references and no public archive hits corroborate Automattic provenance. Region eu-west-1 not determinative (anyone can create a bucket in any region).
